Hi everyone,

I'm excited to share Quantum4Lean v0.8.0, a new independent library for formally verified quantum computing in Lean 4.

What it offers:

  • Complete bit-exact NISQ stack in pure Lean (statevector simulation, observables, noise models, adaptive VQE, QAOA, density matrices)
  • Formal verification of Clifford circuits over ℤ[i] (no floating point) with custom tactics (circuit_equiv, quantum_simp) and an intra-Lean fuzzer
  • Declarative DSL: circuit! { H q[0]; CNOT q[0] q[1] }
  • High-performance FFI bridge to Metal 3 on Apple Silicon
  • OpenQASM 3.0 exporter (including Gate.Unitary)
  • Translators from mathematical problems (Diophantine equations, polynomials) to Ising Hamiltonians for QAOA/VQE
  • Examples in quantum chemistry (exact H₂) and discrete topology
  • Several playgrounds exploring famous problems (Beal’s conjecture, Tijdeman’s equation, Riemann hypothesis ideas...)

Just released v0.8.0 – Primera Edición Fundacional with 24 modules, 12 verified theorems, 200+ tests and CI.

The library is currently self-contained (Lean 4.31.0, no mathlib dependency).

I'm particularly interested in feedback from people working on formal quantum information and physics in Lean. Happy to discuss potential synergies.

Repo: https://github.com/Alektronnik/Quantum4Lean

Looking forward to your thoughts!

Best regards,
Alektronnik
